chapter.name: Shraddha Traya Vibhaga Yoga
chapter.description: Krishna explains how faith (shraddha) varies according to the three gunas—Sattva, Rajas, and Tamas—and how it influences worship, food, sacrifice, austerity, and charity.
chapter.theme: Understanding faith based on gunas and its influence on actions and lifestyle
chapter.yogaType: Jnana Yoga - Analysis of Faith and Conduct

verses.speaker: Arjuna
verses.sanskrit: अर्जुन उवाच | ये शास्त्रविधिमुत्सृज्य यजन्ते श्रद्धयान्विताः | तेषां निष्ठा तु का कृष्ण सत्त्वमाहो रजस्तमः ||
verses.transliteration: arjuna uvāca | ye śāstra-vidhim utsṛjya yajante śraddhayānvitāḥ | teṣāṃ niṣṭhā tu kā kṛṣṇa sattvam āho rajas tamaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Arjuna asked: Those who worship with faith but without following scriptures—what is their nature?
verses.meaning: Arjuna asks about faith without discipline.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रीभगवानुवाच | त्रिविधा भवति श्रद्धा देहिनां सा स्वभावजा | सात्त्विकी राजसी चैव तामसी चेति तां शृणु ||
verses.transliteration: śrī-bhagavān uvāca | tri-vidhā bhavati śraddhā dehināṃ sā svabhāva-jā | sāttvikī rājasī caiva tāmasī ceti tāṃ śṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: Faith is of three kinds: Sattvic, Rajasic, and Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सत्त्वानुरूपा सर्वस्य श्रद्धा भवति भारत | श्रद्धामयोऽयं पुरुषो यो यच्छ्रद्धः स एव सः ||
verses.transliteration: sattvānurūpā sarvasya śraddhā bhavati bhārata | śraddhā-mayo 'yaṃ puruṣo yo yac chraddhaḥ sa eva saḥ ||
verses.english_translation: A person is defined by their faith; as one’s faith is, so are they.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यजन्ते सात्त्विका देवान्यक्षरक्षांसि राजसाः | प्रेतान्भूतगणांश्चान्ये यजन्ते तामसा जनाः ||
verses.transliteration: yajante sāttvikā devān yakṣa-rakṣāṃsi rājasāḥ | pretān bhūta-gaṇāṃś cānye yajante tāmasā janāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Sattvic people worship gods, Rajasic worship spirits, Tamasic worship ghosts.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अशास्त्रविहितं घोरं तप्यन्ते ये तपो जनाः | दम्भाहङ्कारसंयुक्ताः कामरागबलान्विताः ||
verses.transliteration: aśāstra-vihitaṃ ghoraṃ tapyante ye tapo janāḥ | dambhāhaṅkāra-saṃyuktāḥ kāma-rāga-balānvitāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Those who perform severe austerities without scriptural guidance are driven by ego.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कर्शयन्तः शरीरस्थं भूतग्राममचेतसः | मां चैवान्तःशरीरस्थं तान्विद्ध्यासुरनिश्चयान् ||
verses.transliteration: karśayantaḥ śarīra-sthaṃ bhūta-grāmam acetasaḥ | māṃ caivāntaḥ-śarīra-sthaṃ tān viddhy āsura-niścayān ||
verses.english_translation: They harm their body and the divine within; they are demoniac.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आहारस्त्वपि सर्वस्य त्रिविधो भवति प्रियः | यज्ञस्तपस्तथा दानं तेषां भेदमिमं शृणु ||
verses.transliteration: āhāras tv api sarvasya tri-vidho bhavati priyaḥ | yajñas tapas tathā dānaṃ teṣāṃ bhedam imaṃ śṛṇu ||
verses.english_translation: Food, sacrifice, austerity, and charity are also of three kinds.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: आयुःसत्त्वबलारोग्यसुखप्रीतिविवर्धनाः | रस्याः स्निग्धाः स्थिरा हृद्या आहारा सात्त्विकप्रियाः ||
verses.transliteration: āyuḥ-sattva-balārogya-sukha-prīti-vivardhanāḥ | rasyāḥ snigdhāḥ sthirā hṛdyā āhārā sāttvika-priyāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Sattvic foods increase life, strength, health, and happiness.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: कट्वम्ललवणात्युष्णतीक्ष्णरूक्षविदाहिनः | आहारा राजसस्येष्टा दुःखशोकामयप्रदाः ||
verses.transliteration: kaṭv-amla-lavaṇāty-uṣṇa-tīkṣṇa-rūkṣa-vidāhinaḥ | āhārā rājasasy eṣṭā duḥkha-śokāmaya-pradāḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Rajasic foods are bitter, sour, salty, and cause discomfort.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यातयामं गतरसं पूति पर्युषितं च यत् | उच्छिष्टमपि चामेध्यं भोजनं तामसप्रियम् ||
verses.transliteration: yāta-yāmaṃ gata-rasaṃ pūti paryuṣitaṃ ca yat | ucchiṣṭam api cāmedhyaṃ bhojanaṃ tāmasa-priyam ||
verses.english_translation: Tamasic foods are stale, impure, and unhealthy.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्यज्ञो विधिदृष्टो य इज्यते | यष्टव्यमेवेति मनः समाधाय स सात्त्विकः ||
verses.transliteration: aphalākāṅkṣibhir yajño vidhi-dṛṣṭo ya ijyate | yaṣṭavyam eveti manaḥ samādhāya sa sāttvikaḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Sacrifice done without desire for results is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अभिसन्धाय तु फलं दम्भार्थमपि चैव यत् | इज्यते भरतश्रेष्ठ तं यज्ञं विद्धि राजसम् ||
verses.transliteration: abhisandhāya tu phalaṃ dambhārtham api caiva yat | ijyate bharata-śreṣṭha taṃ yajñaṃ viddhi rājasam ||
verses.english_translation: Sacrifice done for reward or show is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: विधिहीनमसृष्टान्नं मन्त्रहीनमदक्षिणम् | श्रद्धाविरहितं यज्ञं तामसं परिचक्षते ||
verses.transliteration: vidhi-hīnam asṛṣṭānnaṃ mantra-hīnam adakṣiṇam | śraddhā-virahitaṃ yajñaṃ tāmasaṃ paricakṣate ||
verses.english_translation: Sacrifice without faith or proper method is Tamasic.
verses.meaning: Lack of discipline leads to failure.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: देवद्विजगुरुप्राज्ञपूजनं शौचमार्जवम् | ब्रह्मचर्यमहिंसा च शारीरं तप उच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: deva-dvija-guru-prājña-pūjanaṃ śaucam ārjavam | brahmacaryam ahiṃsā ca śārīraṃ tapa ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Respect, purity, self-discipline, and non-violence are bodily austerities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अनुद्वेगकरं वाक्यं सत्यं प्रियहितं च यत् | स्वाध्यायाभ्यसनं चैव वाङ्मयं तप उच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: anudvega-karaṃ vākyaṃ satyaṃ priya-hitaṃ ca yat | svādhyāyābhyasanaṃ caiva vāṅ-mayaṃ tapa ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Truthful, kind speech and study are verbal austerities.
verses.meaning: Words should be truthful and beneficial.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मनःप्रसादः सौम्यत्वं मौनमात्मविनिग्रहः | भावसंशुद्धिरित्येतत्तपो मानसमुच्यते ||
verses.transliteration: manaḥ-prasādaḥ saumyatvaṃ maunam ātma-vinigrahaḥ | bhāva-saṃśuddhir ity etat tapo mānasam ucyate ||
verses.english_translation: Serenity, gentleness, silence, self-control, and purity of mind are mental austerities.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: श्रद्धया परया तप्तं तपस्तत्त्रिविधं नरैः | अफलाकाङ्क्षिभिर्युक्तैः सात्त्विकं परिचक्षते ||
verses.transliteration: śraddhayā parayā taptaṃ tapas tat tri-vidhaṃ naraiḥ | aphalākāṅkṣibhir yuktaiḥ sāttvikaṃ paricakṣate ||
verses.english_translation: Austerity practiced with faith and without desire for results is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सत्कारमानपूजार्थं तपो दम्भेन चैव यत् | क्रियते तदिह प्रोक्तं राजसं चलमध्रुवम् ||
verses.transliteration: satkāra-māna-pūjārthaṃ tapo dambhena caiva yat | kriyate tad iha proktaṃ rājasaṃ calam adhruvam ||
verses.english_translation: Austerity done for honor and recognition is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: मूढग्राहेणात्मनो यत्पीडया क्रियते तपः | परस्योत्सादनार्थं वा तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: mūḍha-grāheṇātmano yat pīḍayā kriyate tapaḥ | parasyotsādanārthaṃ vā tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Austerity done with ignorance or to harm others is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: दातव्यमिति यद्दानं दीयतेऽनुपकारिणे | देशे काले च पात्रे च तद्दानं सात्त्विकं स्मृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: dātavyam iti yad dānaṃ dīyate 'nupakāriṇe | deśe kāle ca pātre ca tad dānaṃ sāttvikaṃ smṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Charity given at the right time, place, and to a worthy person is Sattvic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यत्तु प्रत्युपकारार्थं फलमुद्दिश्य वा पुनः | दीयते च परिक्लिष्टं तद्दानं राजसं स्मृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: yat tu pratyupakārārthaṃ phalam uddiśya vā punaḥ | dīyate ca parikliṣṭaṃ tad dānaṃ rājasaṃ smṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Charity given expecting return is Rajasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अदेशकाले यद्दानमपात्रेभ्यश्च दीयते | असत्कृतमवज्ञातं तत्तामसमुदाहृतम् ||
verses.transliteration: adeśa-kāle yad dānam apātrebhyaś ca dīyate | asatkṛtam avajñātaṃ tat tāmasam udāhṛtam ||
verses.english_translation: Charity given at the wrong place or time is Tamasic.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: ॐ तत्सदिति निर्देशो ब्रह्मणस्त्रिविधः स्मृतः | ब्राह्मणास्तेन वेदाश्च यज्ञाश्च विहिताः पुरा ||
verses.transliteration: om tat sad iti nirdeśo brahmaṇas tri-vidhaḥ smṛtaḥ | brāhmaṇās tena vedāś ca yajñāś ca vihitāḥ purā ||
verses.english_translation: Om Tat Sat are the three expressions of the Absolute Truth.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तस्मादोमित्युदाहृत्य यज्ञदानतपःक्रियाः | प्रवर्तन्ते विधानोक्ताः सततं ब्रह्मवादिनाम् ||
verses.transliteration: tasmād om ity udāhṛtya yajña-dāna-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ | pravartante vidhānoktāḥ satataṃ brahma-vādinām ||
verses.english_translation: Actions begin with Om as per scriptures.
verses.meaning: Spiritual acts start with sacred intent.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: तदित्यनभिसन्धाय फलं यज्ञतपःक्रियाः | दानक्रियाश्च विविधाः क्रियन्ते मोक्षकाङ्क्षिभिः ||
verses.transliteration: tad ity anabhisandhāya phalaṃ yajña-tapaḥ-kriyāḥ | dāna-kriyāś ca vividhāḥ kriyante mokṣa-kāṅkṣibhiḥ ||
verses.english_translation: Without attachment to results, actions are performed with 'Tat'.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: सद्भावे साधुभावे च सदित्येतत्प्रयुज्यते | प्रशस्ते कर्मणि तथा सच्छब्दः पार्थ युज्यते ||
verses.transliteration: sad-bhāve sādhu-bhāve ca sad ity etat prayujyate | praśaste karmaṇi tathā sac-chabdaḥ pārtha yujyate ||
verses.english_translation: ‘Sat’ represents truth, goodness, and noble actions.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: यज्ञे तपसि दाने च स्थितिः सदिति चोच्यते | कर्म चैव तदर्थीयं सदित्येवाभिधीयते ||
verses.transliteration: yajñe tapasi dāne ca sthitiḥ sad iti cocyate | karma caiva tad-arthīyaṃ sad ity evābhidhīyate ||
verses.english_translation: Steadiness in sacrifice, austerity, and charity is called ‘Sat’.

verses.speaker: Sri Krishna
verses.sanskrit: अश्रद्धया हुतं दत्तं तपस्तप्तं कृतं च यत् | असदित्युच्यते पार्थ न च तत्प्रेत्य नो इह ||
verses.transliteration: aśraddhayā hutaṃ dattaṃ tapas taptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat | asad ity ucyate pārtha na ca tat pretya no iha ||
verses.english_translation: Actions done without faith are useless both here and hereafter.
verses.meaning: Faith is essential for meaningful action.
